item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03205","case1_error":"Reports 200 pairs instead of converting to the requested 400 individual plugs.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 8 + 12 + 16 + 4 as 30 instead of 40.","reason":"The first answers in the wrong counting unit; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly written sum.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03206","case1_error":"Incorrectly replaces 36 × 9 with 432; the correct product is 324.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 2500 after correct formulas that imply 4500 pages.","reason":"The first shows an explicit multiplication evaluation error; the second supplies an incorrect final number without showing its calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03207","case1_error":"Miscomputes 22 − 7/3 as 22 2/3 and reports yards instead of requested feet.","case2_error":"Assumes walking for all 24 hours each day despite the stated one hour daily.","reason":"The first has a subtraction evaluation error and wrong output units; the second uses an erroneous walking-duration relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03208","case1_error":"Double-counts the two parent lambs by adding them again to the original six.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 100 after the correct expression 20 + (2 × 30), which yields 80.","reason":"The first constructs an incorrect total through double-counting; the second provides an incorrect final number after a correct formula.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03209","case1_error":"Subtracts only Ryan’s share, omitting Chris’s withdrawal entirely.","case2_error":"Uses all 30 students as the last group’s size instead of the remaining five.","reason":"The first omits a required withdrawal; the second substitutes the whole population for a subgroup in the division denominator.","judgment":"different"}]}
